entities.summary: Richard Petruška is a Slovak-Italian former professional basketball player and coach. He was born in Levice, Czechoslovakia. At a height of 6 ft 10 in (2.08 m), and a weight of 260 pounds (120 kg), he played the power forward and center positions.
